title: alint check report (v1)
description: Output schema emitted by `alint check --format json`. Locks the public contract for downstream tooling.

schema_version.description: Report schema version. Always 1 for this schema.

baselined_suppressed.description: Count of violations suppressed by an active `--baseline`. Present only when a baseline is in effect.

baselined.description: Findings suppressed by an active `--baseline`, listed only under `--show-baselined`. Omitted otherwise.

id.description: Rule id, matches the `id:` field of a rule in the config.

passed.description: True when the rule produced zero violations.

policy_url.description: Optional documentation URL provided by the rule.

fixable.description: True when the rule declares an autofix; downstream tools use this to decide whether to suggest `alint fix`.

notes.description: Informational notes (non-violation findings, e.g. entries a rule skipped rather than failed on). Omitted when empty; never affects `passed`.

path.description: Repo-relative path; absent for tree-wide violations.

fixable.description: Whether a bare `alint fix` resolves THIS violation (a Safe, applicable fix). Per-violation, unlike the rule-level `fixable`; an Unsafe or declined fix is false here. A note is always false.

proposed_edit.description: The concrete Safe edit(s) `alint fix` would apply to resolve this violation. Present only under `--include-fixes`, only for a Safe-fixable finding.
A concrete fix edit: replace `region` of `path` with `inserted` (empty for a pure deletion).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the edited file.

baselined.description: A finding grandfathered by the active baseline.

path.description: Repo-relative path; absent for tree-wide findings.
